title: Design Token Discipline
description: Prefer design tokens / CSS variables over raw hex. Customize forbidden patterns in project.invariants.yaml → design.forbidden_hex_patterns.

rules.message: Inline hex Tailwind/class — bypasses theme system.
rules.remediation: Use named design tokens from your theme config. Set design.enabled and token_prefix in project.invariants.yaml.

rules.message: Raw hex in CSS — prefer CSS variables or token map.
rules.remediation: Define tokens in global theme; reference var(--token-name).
